snippet.title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival Negan Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3777850/The_Walking_Dead_Streets_of_Survival/

A new gameplay trailer for sidescrolling brawler The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival focused on the unlockable character, Negan, and his trusty weapon Lucille. It's coming to PC and consoles on the 18th of September.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
